question: Which bodily centers are enumerated as locations for the cakras in this teaching?
premises: Several bodily locations are listed in sequence.
The list includes the secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and end of the tuft.
These locations serve as sites for the cakras.
inference: The cakras are located in the secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and the end of the tuft.
plain_english: In the secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and at the end of the tuft.
